name: San Esteban (Comillas Route 8)
start: Marisma de Zapedo, at the entrance to Rioturbio
highlights: From the shores of the Ría de la Rabia into planted forest up to the Ermita de San Esteban on a small hill: views over the Comillas coast and Monte Corona, recreation area, oak, beech, pine, fir, cypress and chestnut, a viewpoint with panorama boards and an unusually low-lying beech wood below the hermitage; return via Ruiseñada and La Molina. warnings: First stretch climbs steeply; mostly forest tracks with small stones; mud in places. Its middle section coincides with the signposted Monte Corona route.
